results.title: 93rd Academy Awards: Pixar's 'Soul' wins Best Animated Feature award
excerpts:
# 93rd Academy Awards: Pixar's 'Soul' wins Best Animated Feature award
Last October, Disney announced that it would release 'Soul' as a Christmas release exclusively on its streaming service Disney+.
A still from Pixar's 'Soul'. (Photo| IMDb)
A still from Pixar's 'Soul'. (Photo| IMDb)
ANI
Updated on:
26 Apr 2021, 7:50 am
2min read

...

WASHINGTON: The 2021 Oscar for the 'Best Animated Feature Film' was taken home by Pixar's 'Soul', becoming the only film ever to win that award without playing in the US movie theatres.

...

This marked the first time a full-length Pixar feature had been released for home viewing without first playing in movie theaters.

...

It also features original jazz music by Jon Batiste, and a score composed by Oscar winners Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross.

excerpts:
# Pixar's 'Soul' wins best animated feature Academy Award
Dana Murray, left, and Pete Docter, winners of the award for animated feature film for "Soul," pose in the press room at the Oscars on Sunday, April 25, 2021, at Union Station in Los Angeles.
(AP Photo/Chris Pizzello, Pool) Dana Murray, left, and Pete Docter, winners of the award for animated feature film for "Soul," pose in the press room at the Oscars on Sunday, April 25, 2021, at Union Station in Los Angeles.
(AP Photo/Chris Pizzello, Pool) Dana Murray, left, and Pete Docter, winners of the award for animated feature film for "Soul," pose in the press room at the Oscars on Sunday, April 25, 2021, at Union Station in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello, Pool)
Dana Murray, left, and Pete Docter, winners of the award for animated feature film for "Soul," pose in the press room at the Oscars on Sunday, April 25, 2021, at Union Station in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello, Pool)
**LOS ANGELES** – Pixar's “Soul” has won the heart of Oscar voters, continuing the Disney division’s dominance in the best animated feature category.
Sunday night's victory gave Pixar 11 wins in the 20 years since the category was established.
Recommended Videos

...

“This film started as a love letter to jazz, but we had no idea how much jazz would teach us about life,” said Docter, who accepted the Oscar with producer Dana Murray. “We don’t get to control what happens.
